MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hub fits my use of a USB card reader and charging or sync cables because it would make connecting those accessories more convenient.",
    "The external drive has some connection to my camera and memory-card use through backing up files, although I do not need that much capacity now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The internal drives and desktop memory assume I am upgrading a computer, while my purchases have mostly helped me use existing devices.",
    "The DVI cable and Ethernet switch solve connection needs I do not currently have; buying other cables and mounts does not make these useful to me.",
    "The 16TB external drive serves a possible backup purpose, but its capacity goes beyond my current needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated memory-card purchases seem to have been taken as interest in storage of every kind, even though internal computer drives serve a different purpose.",
    "My interest in electronic accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in desktop upgrades and network equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose practical accessories for cameras, tablets, GPS devices and everyday connections, so a clear use with equipment I already use matters.",
    "Compatibility matters: I need a reason to use a particular connector or component, rather than simply another electronic accessory.",
    "My frequent purchases reflect several specific needs over time, not an immediate need to upgrade every part of my setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my need for convenient device connections but mistook my memory-card and accessory purchases for a computer-upgrade project."
}
